scope: Bounded diagnosis and safe fixture-helper diagnostic repair after hosted Records run 37837671077
current_truth: The hosted native run reached C02/C03 but positive C04/C05 remain unverified. Its first fixture diagnostic was records_fixture_recovery_list / unexpected_error with null method and status; the planned journal and separate complete authenticated GET show no fixture write or surviving owned live table.

boundary_findings.first_error: The real fixture request threw before returning to call(). The helper assigned lastRequest only after await request(), so a rejected browser/CDP evaluation erased the attempted GET method and left a generic classification.
boundary_findings.reproduction: The new helper-to-receipt callback guard, using the real recordsFixtureRequest with an injected browser-evaluation exception, failed on the old helper: method null and unexpected_error instead of GET and the fixed panel-runtime category.
boundary_findings.generated_expression: The recovery-list Runtime.evaluate JavaScript expression compiled in a read-only source diagnostic.
boundary_findings.safe_api_discriminator: Separate designated-admin, approved-organization GET returned HTTP 200 with a complete list and zero live exact-marker fixtures. It cannot establish the status or cause of the browser-side request.
boundary_findings.underlying_browser_exception: Not retained by the frozen hosted run; root cause of the browser/CDP throw remains unknown. No native retry was launched in this lane.

repair.behavior: call() now records the attempted method before awaiting the browser request. A thrown Runtime.evaluate error receives one of two fixed categories. The real browser expression catches token-read and token-digest exceptions separately and returns only a fixed phase; the helper attaches that phase to the failure callback before any HTTP request. The callback still rethrows; no retry, fallback, write, or acceptance credit was added.
repair.privacy: Only fixed category and preflight-phase labels, GET, and null status enter the receipt. Arbitrary exception text, bearer, raw API body, organization ID, and record IDs do not.

verification.red_before_fix: Focused guard failed for the observed defect: unexpected_error/request_method null versus panel_runtime_exception/GET.
verification.green_after_fix: 37 targeted fixture/native driver/proof tests passed in 0.34 seconds with external TMPDIR. The preflight guard runs the actual generated browser expression with storage and digest exceptions, then checks the helper-to-receipt callback.
verification.scratch_mutation: Changing only the digest-stage label to token_read in an external scratch copy made the focused phase guard fail; the scratch copy was removed.
verification.format: Biome formatted both touched source files; git diff --check passed.
verification.hosted_focused_gate: Pending owner dispatch against the pushed source.

remaining: A future admitted hosted run is needed to classify the actual browser exception and verify positive C04/C05 plus fixture cleanup. If the result is still panel_runtime_exception, the remaining boundary is CDP/evaluate machinery or another uncaught browser expression error, not a proven API failure.
This patch repairs diagnostic loss, not the unidentified browser/CDP cause.
